title: The Hours We Keep — epiphyte mix illustration revision
method: Seven individual built-in image_gen edit calls, each using one latest canonical source. No pixel editing to plates. Original files retained. Contact-sheet layout created with Pillow, without modifying the plate files.
sources: Cover v14 and six interior v3 finals, excluding Intake Nine draft.
botanical_scope: Additional plant pool used only in previously planted zones; mix varies by scene. Acianthera recurva-inspired miniature form included in workshop only.

references.evidence: NYBG indexed genus description: inflated basal corolla, long narrow deeply divided lobes. Live page 403; pink/white/purple palette is user-requested, no exact species claimed.
NParks: yellow large-lipped flowers on long branched arching spikes; morphology reference not exact cultivar assignment.
NParks: substantial orchid clumps, elongated flower stalks, flowers remain modest relative to plant and architecture.
Kew: dark conspicuous markings on sepals and petals; densely flowered inflorescence.
Kew accepts species and epiphytic habit.

Smithsonian accession image-search result: compact mat of oval leaves, wiry roots, tiny yellow/white/purple flowers under 0.15 inches. Direct collection page returned 520. Artwork uses a miniature foliage-dominant interpretation; not a diagnostic species portrait.
UFSC field specimen identified/photographed by Marcio Verdi, confirms species and whole leaf morphology. Photograph could not be retrieved locally.
